Pros:
-Sick finishing moves
-You get to play as a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ badass ultramarine
-Cool setpieces
-Decent voicework
-It's Warmhammer 40k

Cons:
-You can't skip cutscenes. This made me give up on the final boss as I was sick and tired of it.
-Boss difficulty is kinda too hard even on normal. So many ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ retries ♥♥♥♥!
-Voice overs are limited and repetitive
-Enemies are limited and repetitive. 
-Weapons kinda suck. You can't use enemy weaponry either.
-Jetpack sections are the only times I truly had fun and they are sadly short.
-There is a Titan that you never get to pilot. He just shoots a big laser and that's the end of it. :(
-Half the time you'll die wondering wtf killed you.

Honestly how can you have unskippable cutscenes?! I'm just gonna go on Youtube to watch the ending. Seriously guys wtf.

[h1] So firstly, [/h1]
[b] Do not buy from Steam [/b], but it from a bargain site or something. I was able to get this for $12 so to me this is very worth it, however for the $60 price I'd have to say it's not at all worth to buy it.

The game is super fun, the multiplayer awesome (if you can get a match), the mods are cool and if you just pair this with some banger music you can feel like a badass even when you're getting ♥♥♥♥♥♥.

Overall, super good game despite it's age, only buy from bargaining websites that give a steamkey or if it goes on sale, for best experience get some friends together and do exterminatus and ♥♥♥♥.

I haven't invested a ton of time into the multiplayer and extra modes, but this was the exact thing I was looking for in a singleplayer campaign. Just work through the levels, get to the next section, beat each challenge the game throws at you and finish the game. No sidequests aside from a few collectables, no collecting 10 bear nipples to make the nipple leather pouch for +3 ammo capacity, just play the dman game. 

I beat it in about 7.5 hours (lots of idle time blew out my time with the game). Might go back and play again one day. Awesome to tick a game off of my backlog list!

The game has a really good combat system, although it does feel a little dated, the melee just relies on you tanking hits and recovering health using the finishing moves, no blocks and dodging is janky at best. The ranged combat feels satisfying, with all of the heavy Space Marine weaponry packing the punch it feels like it should. When the game ramps up the challenge, it can be a little frustrating, sending ranged and melee enemies at the same time with it being difficult to manage both enemy types at the same time. A lot of the time it felt like I was cheesing the game hiding behind cover and not marching through hoards of enemies like an Ultramarine should be doing.

Not perfect, but a great game. Grab it for less than $10 when it goes on sale and have a blast!
